seo.title: Beacon | Books-First Discovery Reputation
seo.description: Beacon is a books-first discovery and reputation network where curators make public recommendations and supporters record early conviction.

footer.description: Beacon is a books-first discovery and reputation network. Participation records conviction and curation history; it is not a promise of profit or passive yield.

home.badge: Books first. Reputation second. Ledger always visible.
home.title: A quieter market for better book discovery.
home.description: Beacon helps readers find books through public curation signals: what was recommended, who stood behind it, and how early supporters recorded conviction. The interface keeps books in front and mechanics legible before any wallet action.

book.title: The Long Attention
book.author: Mira Voss
book.thesis: A patient argument for reading as a civic skill, and a useful counterweight to algorithmic drift.

principles.title: Designed to feel literary, not speculative.
principles.description: The design system separates editorial content from participation mechanics so readers can understand what matters without being pushed toward hype or yield framing.

books.title: Book-first hierarchy
books.description: Recommendation pages lead with title, author, curator thesis, and reading context before any stake or support mechanics.

reputation.title: Reputation as context
reputation.description: Curator history, discovery timing, and support records are visible as trust signals, not as leaderboard spectacle.

ledger.title: Mechanics in plain view
ledger.description: Every economic action is presented as a clear record: action, recipient, amount, fee payer, and network cluster.

ledger.title: Every wallet action gets a readable receipt before it is signed.
ledger.description: Beacon should make participation understandable before commitment. Support is a public conviction record and may affect badges, reputation, and milestone eligibility according to the documented model.
ledger.notice: Support is not presented as a refundable vote, guaranteed return, or passive yield product. The interface must explain what the user is doing and what the ledger will record.
ledger.previewDescription: Representative preview for a future support flow.

action.label: Action
action.note: Adds a public participation signal to this recommendation.

recipient.label: Recipient
recipient.note: The program route and accounts are shown before signing.

amount.label: Amount
amount.note: Contribution amount plus network fees are listed separately.

cluster.label: Cluster
cluster.note: Network context is explicit to avoid accidental mainnet actions.
